title: [AUG-20] Add transcript export options (txt, srt, copy text only)
why_we_need_this: The only way to get transcript content out is "Copy Transcript," which copies raw markdown with timestamps. Managers sharing transcripts with teams need clean formats — plain text without timestamps, .srt for subtitles, downloadable .txt.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] "Copy Transcript" button becomes a dropdown with options: "Copy with timestamps", "Copy text only", "Download .txt", "Download .srt"
- [ ] "Copy text only" strips [HH:MM:SS] prefixes and markdown markers
- [ ] "Download .txt" saves a plain text file with timestamps
- [ ] "Download .srt" saves a valid SubRip subtitle file with sequential numbering and timestamp ranges
- [ ] Dropdown uses design tokens and matches the copy button styling
- [ ] "Copied!" feedback shown for copy actions; browser download dialog for file downloads
